scope: Read-only source/history/solver audit before recovery changes

confirmed_code_findings.finding: The inner solve stops at the fixed Newton budget with std::runtime_error; it does not carry the final iterate or recover.
Endpoint catches only NonlinearFailure to enrich diagnostics. It does not recover inner nonlinear failures; changing exception type alone cannot fix convergence.
User iterations sets linear iteration maximum only, leaving default maximum_newton_iterations=40.
Prior directional refinement applies only after at least three halvings with positive derivative bracket. Full or mildly damped steps are untouched.
A full cold hydrodynamic solve is performed even when a valid warm velocity is then selected unconditionally; possible redundant work, not established failure root cause.
Dominant nearfield hydro and Newton factors use Eigen SimplicialLDLT. Requested OpenMP cores do not turn these sparse factorizations into a multithreaded solve.

independent_math_review: No sign inconsistency found between frozen-cap contact responses, assembled Jacobian, and convex objective increment. Normal, sliding, rolling, and twisting terms use the same gap, projections and cap conventions.
interpretation: The recorded step400 is well below overlap threshold and has modest relative viscosity. This supports a numerical nonlinear convergence problem, not an observed physical viscosity divergence. State at failure723 requires replay trace; it is not contained in supplied history.

Compare a robust candidate to a stricter/longer-budget solution on the same frozen equation while preserving physical residual acceptance.
